variables.systemTrivia: Magnavox Odyssey 2 is a home video game console developed by Philips. First released in Quartier de l'Europe in December 1978 and discontinued in 1984. It launched at $179 in the US. About 2 million units were sold. Its library has 80 games. It followed the Odyssey and was succeeded by the Odyssey 100. Processors include the Intel MCS-48.
